sha_binding.verified_source_note: Every count and every command output in this bundle was re-measured on 12b0d00f after this lane was rebased a fourth time onto origin/main (past UTV2-1604, UTV2-1632 x2, UTV2-1635, UTV2-1613, UTV2-1594, UTV2-1399). The authoritative binding is the squash merge SHA, written post-merge by post-merge-lane-close.yml via ops:proof-generate --merge-sha.

verifier.method: This lane's central claim is a count and a reachability verdict, both of which are mechanical and reproducible by anyone running `pnpm ops:automation-coverage-check`. No count is asserted from narrative. The prior audit's reported figures (430 test files, 175 unreachable, 8 orphan ops scripts) were re-derived rather than accepted, and none of them reproduced.
verifier.verifier_scope: Static and mechanical. This lane touches no database path; the changed files are scripts/ops/executable-wiring.ts, scripts/ops/automation-coverage-check.ts, their tests, the baseline ledger, a spec doc and the root package.json test:ops list. The T1 live-DB requirement is satisfied by ci.yml's staging-db-proof job, which runs on this head like every other pull request; see runtime_proof.
verifier.independence_note: The reachability claims do not rest on the implementing agent's reading of the code. Each named merge-path test was cross-checked with an independent grep of package.json and .github/ (verification.md EVIDENCE 5), and each newly wired test was mutation-checked so that a decorative test could not pass as coverage (EVIDENCE 6).
verifier.runtime_proof_harvest_note: The T1 live-DB requirement (runtime_proof below) was harvested post-merge via the governed pnpm ops:proof-repair path from this PR (#1338) own Writable DB proof (staging only) CI job -- never re-run, never fabricated. identity is deliberately distinct from manifest.created_by (codex-cli) per P10/R3.

reported_by_prior_audit.note: Not hardcoded anywhere in the implementation. The prior audit over-counted unreachable tests, under-counted orphan capabilities by more than 2x, and named proof-auditor-gate.test.ts as unexecuted when it is in fact required-reachable.

mutation_check.method: Each newly wired test is paired with the module it actually imports or spawns. The module is mutated (every === inverted to !== and every && to ||; for the CLI-spawning contract test, one of its five declared checks is removed), the test re-run, and the module byte-restored. A test that survives mutation is decorative.
mutation_check.harness_correction: An earlier round paired review.test.ts, review-verdict.test.ts and proof-check.test.ts with their same-named CLI entrypoints and recorded SURVIVED. That was a harness error: those tests import review-state-schema.ts and proof-schema.ts. Re-pairing against the module actually under test kills all three. Recorded rather than dropped.

defects_surfaced.detail: The Runtime Verifier Gate exits 0 when a merge SHA is supplied and is absent from the proof file, so core invariant 4 (proof must tie to the merge SHA) is not enforced by the gate that exists to enforce it.
12 failures; the merge policy engine has drifted from its test contract.
Asserts scripts/ops/worktree-setup.ps1 is a deprecated stub; it is not.

POSIX sh collapses ** to a single path segment, so the nested test under apps/qa-agent/src/adapters/... never runs. Verified against pnpm directly, not assumed. Reported as WIRING_GLOB_SHADOWED (warn).

Their package test scripts exist but the root test script never chains them, so proof-bundle, proof-validator, merge-sha-binding, proof-freshness and certification tests are outside the required verify floor.

baseline.shrink_only: max_entries caps both sections. Entries that become reachable, become non-executable fixtures, or point at deleted files are stale and fail, which forces the ledger down. Expiry lapse is a warning, not a failure, so a calendar date can never block every merge in the program.
